settings.messaging.lark.instructions:
1. Откройте открытую платформу Lark (жаворонок) или открытую платформу Feishu (feishu) и создайте собственное приложение.
2. Скопируйте идентификатор приложения (cli_…) и секрет приложения.
3. Включите области im:message + im:message.group_at_msg + im:message:send_as_bot.
4. Подписаться на событие im.message.receive_v1 в режиме длительного соединения.
5. Оставьте поле «Ключ шифрования» пустым — в режиме длительного соединения шифрование полезной нагрузки не используется.

superAgent.abilityHint: Save reusable instructions and assign them to specific nodes.
superAgent.actionGateApprovalHint: Approve this node and invocation once. The complete parameters and environment must match. Approval cannot be remembered, shared or expand permissions.
superAgent.actionGatesHint: With full control off, verified read-only tools run autonomously; writes, external communication, spending, infrastructure changes and unknown operations require human approval. Full control skips all approvals and Auto-review.
superAgent.analystDescription: Organize information, verify facts and data, and provide supported analysis.
superAgent.analystPreferences: Use existing files and bound sources. Align dates, units and definitions; preserve sources, formulas and assumptions. Check totals, duplicates and outliers. Link claims to evidence, distinguish verified items and provide concise reusable inputs.
superAgent.autoReviewHint: With full control off, a separate tool-free review uses the current connection and model credits. Review can be wrong; failure requires human review and a consistent verdict still requires approval. Full control skips the reviewer and retains this setting for later.
superAgent.boardHint: Shared by all nodes. Updates require the current revision to prevent overwriting another node.
superAgent.checkRunnerDescription: Run specified builds, tests and static checks, preserving actual output and failure evidence.
superAgent.checkRunnerPreferences: Wait for the assigned revision and dependencies; run supplied commands in the specified directory. Record revision, commands, exit codes, log paths and key errors. Exit code zero alone does not establish acceptance. Do not change implementation, assertions or check configuration, or independently install dependencies or update lockfiles. Escalate missing commands, environment mismatches and failures with original evidence for developer or tester diagnosis; avoid repeating failed commands.
superAgent.codeAssistantDescription: Locate files and call sites, summarize interfaces and perform explicitly scoped mechanical edits.
superAgent.codeAssistantPreferences: Read repository rules and search assigned symbols and paths, returning locations and source evidence. Limit edits to explicitly assigned documentation, renames or repetitive changes; preserve user edits. Do not independently refactor or change public interfaces, authorization or business logic. Inspect the full diff, run assigned checks and report paths, commands and actual results. Escalate ambiguity, dependency conflicts and nonmechanical issues for developer handling.
superAgent.codeLeadDescription: Plan scenario tasks, dependencies, resources and evidence-based acceptance.
superAgent.codeLeadPreferences: Define interfaces and acceptance before development. Use reviewOf for independent tests and review of the same revision. Declare exclusive file resources; repair failures using evidence without repeating successful stages.
superAgent.codeReviewerDescription: Review complex design, correctness, security and difficult failures when needed.
superAgent.codeReviewerPreferences: Handle assigned critical issues. Read the diff and contract; report findings by impact with locations, evidence and fixes. Avoid speculative defects, style refactors and repeating completed tests. State remaining risks when approving.
superAgent.codingDescription: Dependency-driven engineering: development, independent testing and review, then acceptance with exclusive file ownership.
superAgent.collaborationAssistantDescrip: Assist existing workers with explicit steps; check artifact structure, links and completeness, and organize execution evidence.
superAgent.collaborationAssistantPrefere: Use the collaborator, input revision, paths, steps and acceptance checklist assigned by the coordinator. Wait for dependencies, perform explicit supporting operations, check file usability, fields, attachments, links and source mappings, and record omissions and evidence. Edit only assigned files without concurrent edits to another worker’s artifact. Avoid repeating specialist analysis or review and do not independently change conclusions, formulas or acceptance criteria. Escalate conflicts, complex decisions and failures with original evidence; report actual completion and unverified items.
superAgent.communicationHint: Messages carry sender, recipient, type, time and task links. Nodes report progress and use the board to hand off information.
superAgent.continuousWorkHint: Enabled by default. Advance unfinished authorized plans and review after the configured team idle interval. The interval is adjustable. Requires the server to be running.
superAgent.coordinatorDescription: Understand goals, constraints and acceptance; hand off to the orchestrator and relay results.
superAgent.coordinatorRule: The main node handles intent and interaction; the orchestrator plans dependencies and acceptance; workers execute and verify. Internal instructions stay hidden.
superAgent.customDescription: Choose each model, thinking level and work preferences.
superAgent.customRulesHint: Match exact tool names to deny actions or require human approval. Deny rules always apply; full control skips human approval rules. Use script-run for registered scripts.
superAgent.dailyDescription: Separate intent and lightweight planning; use daily execution, organization and artifact checks as needed.
superAgent.dailyLeadDescription: Plan scenario tasks, dependencies, resources and evidence-based acceptance.
superAgent.dailyLeadPreferences: Use short flows with worker self-checks for simple tasks. Assign organization and artifact checks only when needed; declare dependencies and acceptance criteria.
superAgent.dailyWorkerDescription: Handle searches, file organization, everyday writing and authorized errands.
superAgent.dailyWorkerPreferences: Inspect existing material and use only necessary tools. Return concise results, sources or file paths and actual status. Verify current schedules and prices. Follow the user’s authorization for sending, payment and booking.
superAgent.developerDescription: Implement features and fixes with sufficient checks and a change summary.
superAgent.developerPreferences: Follow repository rules and inspect code and tests. Reuse the architecture, preserve user edits and avoid unrelated refactoring or placeholders. Run relevant checks; report commands, exit status, changed paths, coverage and unverified items.
superAgent.diagnosticianDescription: Inspect logs, request paths and runtime state to locate causes and impact.
superAgent.diagnosticianPreferences: Preserve timestamps, request IDs, nodes and errors. Separate symptoms and causes; propose minimal remediation and recovery checks.
superAgent.emptyBoard: The board is empty. Nodes can share findings, progress and results here.
superAgent.exactApprovalHint: Authorize only this node and operation. The grant ends with the current turn or its expiry.
superAgent.executionModeHint: The coordinator and all workers use Execute. Capability switches, the work environment and scoped approvals still control access.
superAgent.experimentDescription: Establish baselines and run reproducible experiments or analysis with methods and raw results.
superAgent.experimentPreferences: Check data provenance, permissions, quality, units and splits. Freeze inputs and parameters; preserve code, dependencies, seeds, commands and results. Compare baselines and alternatives, report uncertainty and avoid leakage. Report negative results; distinguish planned from executed work and correlation from causation.
superAgent.folderDescription: Work in the selected folder with the file and tool permissions below.
superAgent.folderIsolation: Folder permissions do not provide operating system isolation. Connect a sandbox or VM executor for stronger isolation.
superAgent.folderPrograms: All shell commands and scripts require a verified container sandbox. Folder mode supports mediated file and browser tools.
superAgent.fullControlBoundary: Full control is on: operations within the execution boundary run directly, and pending approvals within that boundary resume automatically. Turn it off to restore approval rules.
superAgent.fullControlDescription: Enable all worker capabilities and skip all human approvals, Action Gates and Auto-review. Folder, source, deny rules and container boundaries still apply; programs and scripts still require a container.
superAgent.fullControlPermissionHint: Full control is on: all human approvals, Action Gates and Auto-review are skipped, and pending operations within the boundary resume automatically. Turn it off to restore approval rules.

superAgent.intentLeadDescription: Understand goals, constraints and acceptance; hand off to the orchestrator and relay results or clarifications.
superAgent.intentLeadPreferences: Handle intent and interaction only. Hand off with intent; reuse existing reports for status requests.

superAgent.literaturePreferences: Prefer primary papers, official data and methods. Record titles, authors, dates, links or DOIs, supporting locations and conditions. Distinguish full texts from abstracts, check versions and seek contrary evidence. Flag inaccessible sources; never invent citations or data.

superAgent.operationsDescription: Evidence-based diagnosis, authorized remediation and independent verification, with exclusive service ownership and recovery checkpoints.
superAgent.operationsLeadDescription: Coordinate diagnosis, remediation, service ownership and recovery conditions.
superAgent.operationsLeadPreferences: Gather request, node and time-window evidence before remediation. Use dependencies and exclusive service resources. Verify with reviewOf and accept using recovery evidence; route missing decisions to the intent node.
superAgent.operationsReviewerDescription: Independently verify the failing route, recovery metrics and change impact.
superAgent.operationsReviewerPreferences: Verify the actual failing route, node and time window on the remediated revision. Record results and gaps; health checks alone do not prove resolution.
superAgent.operatorDescription: Perform authorized remediation and record changes and recovery checkpoints.
superAgent.operatorPreferences: Change assigned services and configuration only. Confirm current state and recovery steps; record operations and results. Inspect uncertain outcomes before retrying.
superAgent.orchestratorDescription: Plan intent, coordinate dependencies and resources, and accept worker evidence.
superAgent.organizerDescription: Extract fields, classify, deduplicate, index and format supplied material; leave complex analysis to specialists.
superAgent.organizerPreferences: Use only assigned files, sources and fields. Follow the supplied template and retain source locations, links, units and dates. Mark missing fields and list conflicts without inventing facts or citations; retain provenance when deduplicating and require authorization to change originals. Return structured tables or indexes with paths, counts and field checks. Escalate source credibility, research conclusions, statistical interpretation and complex formulas to the coordinator.

superAgent.permissionHint: Capabilities define the execution boundary. Reads run autonomously; side effects require Action Gate approval in the main chat. Approval cannot allow an operation outside the boundary.
superAgent.permissionManagementHint: All nodes use this workspace approval inbox. Action Gates require approval for each invocation and cannot be shared. Historic shared grants can be viewed and revoked.
superAgent.planHint: The coordinator schedules work by priority, records progress and blockers, and verifies completion. You can also add or edit plans.
superAgent.preferencesPlaceholder: For example: verify before concluding, write concise results, reuse existing files.
superAgent.presetDescription: Setups use available text models in the selected connection and group, with role-based choices and fallback to available models. All settings remain editable.
superAgent.presetReplaceHint: Applying a setup updates roles, models and continuous work. Environment permissions and existing resource bindings are retained. Save to apply.
superAgent.presetUnavailable: Connect an available text model to use a recommended setup.
superAgent.producerDescription: Create documents, spreadsheets, reports and authorized operation results from confirmed inputs.
superAgent.producerPreferences: Inspect templates and formats; tailor deliverables to the audience and decisions. Reuse verified data without invented facts. Check layout, links, formulas and attachments. Deliver usable files and paths. Follow explicit authorization for sending or business updates and report actual outcomes.

superAgent.researchDescription: Parallel literature and data preparation, experiments on verified inputs and independent review of methods and claims.
superAgent.researchLeadDescription: Plan scenario tasks, dependencies, resources and evidence-based acceptance.
superAgent.researchLeadPreferences: Parallelize independent literature and data preparation; freeze provenance, data and hypotheses before experiments. Use reviewOf for independent reproduction; gaps drive bounded follow-up.
superAgent.researchReviewerDescription: Independently review evidence, methods and claim strength; reproduce key results.
superAgent.researchReviewerPreferences: Review the question and original artifacts, not only summaries. Check citations, baselines, sampling and statistics; recompute key metrics when possible. Separate facts, inferences and hypotheses; report counterexamples, limitations, gaps and minimal follow-up checks.
superAgent.reusedConnections: Reuse your agent AI settings and TokenNest sign-in. Credentials stay in the existing settings.
superAgent.sandboxDescription: Execute in Docker or Podman. The server checks the runtime and image.

superAgent.scriptPathHint: Must be inside the work folder. Supports .js, .mjs, .cjs, .py, .sh and .ps1.

superAgent.testerDescription: Independently reproduce issues and verify acceptance, boundaries and regression risks.
superAgent.testerPreferences: Derive checks from requirements. Wait for a runnable revision, run existing tests and add necessary boundary checks. Record revision, commands, exit codes and reproductions. Do not change implementation code; report failures and verification scope.

superAgent.workLeadDescription: Plan scenario tasks, dependencies, resources and evidence-based acceptance.
superAgent.workLeadPreferences: Build deliverable dependencies, templates, input revisions and owners. Prepare inputs, parallelize independent analysis and production, assign one document writer and use reviewOf for quality checks.
superAgent.workReviewerDescription: Check critical facts, numbers, formatting and acceptance for missing work.
superAgent.workReviewerPreferences: Check final artifacts against requirements and sources; recompute critical numbers and inspect links and usability.
